evidence: crates/susi-daemon/src/server.rs (run_daemon_loop invokes migrate_state_dir(&global_dir) at boot, before ensure_api_auth_token_seeded and any other schema-dependent access, and aborts startup on failure) and crates/susi-config/src/state_migration.rs (read_version consults state.schema.json at runtime; backup dirs are .migrate-bak-<secs>-<pid>-<nanos> so a same-second retry cannot clobber the preserved pre-migration bytes); pinned by vc_201_065_mastery tests in susi-config (success path preserves bytes + marks version, rollback retries, interrupted-rerun durability) and susi-daemon (boot ordering, fatal-on-failure, manifest read at runtime).
missing: A crash between the backup and the version-marker write leaves an orphaned .migrate-bak-* directory behind, and the retry backup preserves the healed (not original) config.json — the true original survives only in the earlier backup directory.
